lines.t: I have laid my heart open
Before your eyes and into your ears
As a harpist playing soft music
Plucking each string with delicate fingers
I reveal the song of my heart to you
With precise strokes in gentle tones of healing
With many notes of unending love
And by soothing vibrations of peace
Did the sound of my love speak
And I, even I, the Lord of hosts
I, even I, the Lord of hosts
